# ArcGIS Pro Salah MCP - full reference

> MCP server (FastMCP, stdio) that lets an AI agent drive the Esri ArcGIS stack end to end: ArcPy geoprocessing on .aprx projects and geodatabases (`pro_*`), the OPEN ArcGIS Pro session through a .NET add-in (`live_*`), ArcGIS Online / Enterprise through the ArcGIS API for Python (`portal_*`, signed in through ArcGIS Pro automatically), and static ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript 5.0 web apps and dashboards (`webapp_*`). 72 tools in 14 toolsets, 23 resources (playbooks, live project, my content) + 1 resource template (one portal item) and 11 prompts. Every tool returns `{"ok": true, "data": ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": ...}` (usually with a `code`).

Generated by `scripts/build_llms.py` from the code (72 tools: core 14, live 6, egdb 8, geoai 5, unet 5, schema 4, validate 3, authoring 3, portal_base 10, portal_data 3, portal_maps 2, portal_admin 5, portal_analysis 2, webapp 2). Re-run it after changing tools.

Key facts for an agent using these tools:

- Related operations share one tool with an `action` argument (e.g. `pro_layer action=add|remove|rename|...`,
  `portal_item action=get|update|move|delete|export|...`). A wrong action returns `code: "bad_action"` listing the
  valid ones; missing arguments are reported before any backend is touched.
- Speed comes from fewer round trips: read with `pro_context` (one call), chain GP tools with `pro_pipeline`, and run
  several tools of any layer in ONE call with `pro_batch` (`{{call1.data.<path>}}` passes a result to a later
  call; `parallel=true` for independent calls). Anything long - geodatabases, maintenance, training, exports,
  clones - takes `background=true` and is polled with `pro_server(action="job", job_id=...)`.
  `pro_server(action="status")` answers at once: warm-ups, what the ArcPy thread is doing, portal connections, jobs.
- The server runs under ArcGIS Pro's own Python (`arcgispro-py3`). ArcPy cannot attach to a running ArcGIS Pro, so
  `pro_*` tools work on files on disk. `"CURRENT"` as a project path is resolved to the project open in Pro through
  the live bridge. `live_*` needs ArcGIS Pro running with the SalahAIBridge add-in (0.1.6) on 127.0.0.1:2026.
- Portal tools sign in by themselves: the ArcGIS Pro sign-in first (`GIS("pro")`, Online or Enterprise, SSO
  included), then a profile, then `username` + `password_env`. `portal_connect(action="whoami")` shows the user,
  role and what it can do. Named connections (`connection="source"` / `"target"`) work across orgs.
- When no curated tool fits: `portal_api` (search / doc of the INSTALLED arcgis library, deprecations flagged) ->
  `portal_python mode=read` -> `portal_python mode=write confirm=true`. `portal_rest` for raw REST.
- Irreversible, bulk, public, admin or credit-spending operations refuse with `code: "confirm_required"` and a
  `preview` until called again with `confirm=True`. Ask the user first. Every portal write is audited.
- Never put a password in a tool argument: tools take the NAME of an environment variable (`password_env`,
  `dba_password_env`, `api_key_env`). Enterprise geodatabase creation needs the user's own keycodes
  (`authorization_file` or `ARCGIS_EGDB_AUTHORIZATION_FILE`).
- Playbooks: `pro_server(action="guide", topic=...)` (workflow, performance, portal-users, portal-layers,
  gotchas, safety, egdb, ...; no topic lists them), also MCP resources `arcgis://guide/<topic>`. Attach an item
  as context with the resource template `arcgis://portal/item/{item_id}`. Reusable workflows are MCP prompts
  (plan_big_task, onboard_users_from_csv, org_audit, ...).
- `ARCGIS_SALAH_TOOLSETS` keeps only some groups, e.g. `core,portal` (`portal` = every portal group) or `core,egdb`.

## Install and run

```bat
:: install into ArcGIS Pro's interpreter (the only one with ArcPy; it also ships the ArcGIS API for Python)
"C:\Program Files\ArcGIS\Pro\bin\Python\envs\arcgispro-py3\python.exe" -m pip install -e .
:: run (normally the MCP client starts it)
"C:\Program Files\ArcGIS\Pro\bin\Python\envs\arcgispro-py3\python.exe" -m arcgis_pro_salah_mcp.server
```

MCP client entry (Claude Desktop `claude_desktop_config.json`; Antigravity takes the same block):

```json
"mcpServers": {
  "arcgis-pro-salah": {
    "command": "C:\\Program Files\\ArcGIS\\Pro\\bin\\Python\\envs\\arcgispro-py3\\python.exe",
    "args": ["-m", "arcgis_pro_salah_mcp.server"],
    "env": {"ARCGIS_SALAH_TOOLSETS": "core,portal,egdb", "ARCGIS_EGDB_AUTHORIZATION_FILE": "C:\\path\\to\\your\\keycodes"}
  }
}
```

After updating the code, fully quit and reopen the MCP client: it keeps the server process it started, and an
editable install only takes effect in a new process. The live bridge needs the SalahAIBridge add-in (0.1.6):
build `SalahAIBridge\SalahAIBridge.csproj`, close ArcGIS Pro, double-click the `.esriAddinX`.

## How the server runs tools

- One dedicated thread imports and runs ArcPy (like ArcGIS Pro's Main CIM Thread). With PostgreSQL geodatabases,
  ArcPy calls made on any other thread failed (`arcpy.ListVersions` ERROR 87395, `ArcSDESQLExecute` ERROR 87413).
- Tools never block the server: ArcPy tools queue on that thread, the others (portal, live, webapp, the batch
  runner) run on worker threads, so status and portal calls are answered while a long ArcPy call runs.
- At start-up arcpy is imported in the background (~25 s); when a portal toolset is on, `arcgis` is imported right
  after (17 s once arcpy is loaded), the ArcGIS Pro sign-in is reused (`GIS("pro")`, ~1 s) and the index of the
  installed arcgis library is loaded (13 s to build once per arcgis version, then a disk cache). A portal call that
  arrives earlier waits for that import (one lock: arcgis has internal circular imports and two threads importing
  it at once failed with "partially initialized module").
- Library `print()` output is routed to stderr so it can never corrupt the MCP stdio channel.

## Workflows

### Analyze, publish, visualize
1. `pro_context` on the project or geodatabase, then `pro_analysis` / `pro_pipeline`.
2. `pro_batch`: `portal_publish` (file, .gdb, feature class or CSV) -> `portal_layer_schema action=renderer` ->
   `portal_map action=create` with `"layers": ["{{call1.data.published_item.id}}"]`.
3. `webapp_create kind=dashboard`, then `webapp_github_pipeline` to deploy to GitHub Pages.

### Onboard users from a CSV
`portal_onboard action=template` -> fill it -> `action=validate` (every row checked; nothing changes) ->
`action=run confirm=true` (preset roles such as "GIS Specialist" created on demand, user type set before role,
never created directly as admin, each account re-read, report CSV without passwords).

### Filtered read-only view for a dashboard
`portal_layer_schema action=create_view view_where="..." view_fields=[...] updateable=false` -> share the VIEW ->
`portal_map action=create` -> `webapp_create kind=dashboard`.

### Enterprise geodatabase, start to finish
`pro_egdb_setup action=create` (background) -> `pro_egdb_connection action=create` -> `pro_egdb_principals` ->
`pro_egdb_privileges` -> `pro_egdb_dataset action=prepare|register_versioned|archiving` -> `pro_egdb_versions` ->
`pro_egdb_replica` -> `pro_egdb_admin action=maintenance`. See `arcgis://guide/egdb`.

### Workflow -> reusable tool
`pro_create_python_toolbox` with `steps` (keyword arguments; `{{param}}` = a tool parameter, `{{stepN}}` = an
earlier output path, `{{memory}}` = an in-memory intermediate deleted when the tool ends) or `execute_code`. It is
added to the open project. The first time Pro loads a `.pyt` it shows a "trust the code source" dialog.

### Deep-learning notebook
`pro_dl_notebook(goal="detect buildings")` returns the recommended `arcgis.learn` model and the questions; ask the
user, then call again with the answers.

## Prompts

- `analyze_publish_visualize`(data, question, share_with) - Analyze in Pro, publish, build a web app
- `create_filtered_view_for_dashboard`(item_id, where, view_name, group) - Filtered read-only view for a dashboard
- `dl_notebook_interview`(goal) - Deep-learning training notebook
- `enterprise_gdb_setup`(platform, instance, database) - Set up an enterprise geodatabase
- `explore_arcgis_api`(task) - Do something no curated tool covers
- `migrate_items_between_orgs`(item_ids, target_folder) - Migrate items between orgs or folders
- `onboard_users_from_csv`(csv_path) - Onboard users from a CSV
- `org_audit`(days) - Org audit and usage report
- `plan_big_task`(goal) - Plan and run a big ArcGIS task fast
- `publish_csv_and_share`(csv_path, title, group) - Publish a CSV and share it
- `workflow_to_toolbox`(workflow) - Turn a workflow into a geoprocessing tool

## Verified pitfalls (and how the tools handle them)

- arcgis 2.4.3 `create_view`: `view_layers` is annotated `list[int]` but needs layer objects, and `visible_fields` /
  `query` make it read the new view's layers before they exist ("list index out of range") - both left a view item
  behind on ArcGIS Online. The tool creates the view plain and applies the filter and visible fields itself.
- A `Group` object hydrates lazily: reading `group.id` after `group.delete()` raises 400; ids are read first.
- Non-admin accounts get 403 on `gis.users.license_types`; known user-type aliases are used instead.
- `ContentManager.add`, `Item.share`, `ContentManager.create_folder` are deprecated (removed in arcgis 3.0) and not
  used; `portal_api` flags 66 deprecated symbols in the installed version.
- `ReconcileVersions` compares version names case-sensitively and silently skips a mismatch while reporting success;
  names are resolved to their stored spelling and the reconcile log decides `reconciled` / `posted`.
- The DEFAULT version is `dbo.DEFAULT` in a DBO-schema SQL Server geodatabase; it is looked up, not assumed.
- On a point-in-time connection `GetCount` returns today's count while a cursor returns the historical rows.
- A SQL Server login that still has sessions cannot be dropped; the tool returns the `KILL` statements for a DBA.
- ModelBuilder models with multi-input tools or folder/file/layer intermediates did not validate; `pro_create_model`
  refuses them with `code: "unsupported_model"`.

## Configuration (environment variables)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_TOOLSETS` | all | Comma list of toolsets to keep (`core` always kept; `portal` = every portal group) |
| `ARCGIS_EGDB_AUTHORIZATION_FILE` | - | Your own keycodes file for enterprise geodatabase create/enable |
| `ARCGIS_BRIDGE_PORT` | `2026` | Live bridge port (server and add-in) |
| `ARCGIS_BRIDGE_READONLY` | `false` | Refuse every mutating `live_*` command |
| `ARCGIS_PORTAL_URL` | `https://www.arcgis.com` | Portal for non-Pro sign-ins |
| `ARCGIS_PROFILE` / `ARCGIS_USERNAME` | - | Profile / user for `portal_connect` when Pro is not signed in |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_AUDIT_LOG` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\arcgis_pro_salah_mcp\audit.jsonl` | Portal write audit log (`off` disables) |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_MAX_EDITS` | `5000` | Feature edits per `portal_layer_edit` call |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_MAX_USERS` | `200` | Rows per onboarding run |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_CREDIT_LIMIT` | `100` | Most credits one confirmed call may spend |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_ALLOW_PORTAL_WRITE_EXEC` | `true` | `false` disables `portal_python mode=write` |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_REST_HOSTS` | - | Extra hosts `portal_rest` may call |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_NO_PORTAL_WARMUP` | `0` | Skip the background arcgis import / Pro sign-in |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_CACHE_DIR` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\arcgis_pro_salah_mcp` | Where the arcgis API index is cached |
| `ARCGIS_JS_SDK_VERSION` | `5.0` | Maps SDK for JavaScript version in generated apps |
| `ARCGIS_WEBAPP_OUT` | `webapp-build` | Output folder for generated apps |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_CACHE_TTL` | `300` | Schema-cache TTL in seconds (`0` disables) |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_NO_WARMUP` | `0` | Skip the background arcpy import |
| `ARCGIS_SALAH_NO_REEXEC` / `CLI_ANYTHING_ARCGIS_PYTHON` | - | Non-standard ArcGIS Pro Python location |

## Tool reference

Every tool returns `{"ok": true, "data": ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}`, usually with a `code` (e.g. `confirm_required`, `bad_action`, `bad_argument`, `readonly`, `forbidden`, `exception`).
Related operations share a tool with an `action` (or `kind` / `what` / `task` / `operation`) argument.
Parameters are listed as `name: type = default`; parameters without a default are required.

### Toolset `core` (14 tools) - everyday ArcPy on .aprx/.gdb files, one-call project context, pipelines, batches, background jobs, server status (always kept)

#### `pro_analysis`
Common geoprocessing: buffer (distance e.g. '100 Meters') | clip (mask) | spatial_join (join_features) | dissolve (field optional) | merge (dataset = list) | reproject (target_crs e.g. 'EPSG:4326') | repair (in place) | extract (where). Several in a row -> pro_pipeline; any other GP tool -> pro_run_gp.

- `operation: str`
- `dataset: str | list[str]`
- `out: str | None = None`
- `distance: str | None = None`
- `mask: str | None = None`
- `join_features: str | None = None`
- `field: str | None = None`
- `target_crs: str | None = None`
- `where: str | None = None`

#### `pro_batch`
Run several tools (any layer) in ONE round trip: calls=[{"tool":"portal_publish","arguments":{...}}, {"tool":"portal_map","arguments":{"layers":["{{call1.data.published_item.id}}"]}}]. {{callN.<path>}} = a value from call N's result (1-based; {{prev...}} = the previous call). parallel=true runs independent calls concurrently (no references; ArcPy calls still run one at a time). background=true returns a job_id (poll pro_server action=job) - use it for anything long.

- `calls: list[dict]`
- `background: bool = False`
- `parallel: bool = False`
- `stop_on_error: bool = True`
- `label: str | None = None`

#### `pro_context`
START HERE. Everything about a project/workspace in ONE call: maps, layers, schemas, row counts, sample rows and inferred themes. Give an .aprx ("CURRENT" = the project open in Pro), a .gdb workspace, or explicit datasets.

- `aprx_path: str | None = None`
- `workspace: str | None = None`
- `datasets: list[str] | None = None`
- `sample_rows: int = 3`
- `max_datasets: int = 25`
- `map_name: str | None = None`

#### `pro_execute_code`
Escape hatch: run arbitrary ArcPy Python (`arcpy` pre-imported; print() is returned as stdout).

- `code: str`

#### `pro_export`
Export: a dataset to a file (format from out_path extension), or a layout to PDF/PNG/JPG (format from extension; dpi), or what="map_series" for a layout's map book as one PDF.

- `out_path: str`
- `dataset: str | None = None`
- `aprx_path: str = 'CURRENT'`
- `layout_name: str | None = None`
- `what: str | None = None`
- `dpi: int | None = None`

#### `pro_field`
Fields: add (field_type TEXT/SHORT/LONG/DOUBLE/DATE) | calculate (Python expression, e.g. "!POP! / !AREA!").

- `action: str`
- `dataset: str`
- `field: str`
- `field_type: str = 'TEXT'`
- `expression: str | None = None`

#### `pro_find_layers`
Search layers by meaning ("which layer has population data?") without reading every schema.

- `query: str`
- `aprx_path: str | None = None`
- `workspace: str | None = None`
- `limit: int = 10`

#### `pro_layer`
Map layers in an .aprx: add (data_path) | remove | rename (new_name) | visibility (visible) | opacity (0.0-1.0).

- `action: str`
- `aprx_path: str = 'CURRENT'`
- `layer_name: str | None = None`
- `map_name: str | None = None`
- `data_path: str | None = None`
- `new_name: str | None = None`
- `visible: bool | None = None`
- `opacity: float | None = None`

#### `pro_pipeline`
Run several GP tools in ONE call, chaining outputs: steps=[{"tool":"analysis.Buffer","args":[...],"kwargs":{...}}]; {{prev}} / {{step2}} inside args = an earlier step's output. background=true returns a job_id at once (poll pro_server action=job).

- `steps: list[dict]`
- `stop_on_error: bool = True`
- `background: bool = False`
- `label: str | None = None`

#### `pro_project`
Project: info (maps, layouts, default gdb, CRS) | layers (a map's layers: name, type, CRS, visibility) | save (copy_to = saveACopy). Edits saved from here to the OPEN project are overwritten when Pro saves - use live_* for the open session.

- `action: str = 'info'`
- `aprx_path: str = 'CURRENT'`
- `map_name: str | None = None`
- `copy_to: str | None = None`

#### `pro_query`
Read a feature class/table: rows (attribute rows; where/order_by optional; geometry excluded) | count (rows matching where) | summary (count, fields, geometry, CRS - cached) | describe (infer what the layer is: item summary/description/tags) | stats (count/sum/mean/median/std/min/max of numeric `field`).

- `action: str = 'rows'`
- `dataset: str = ''`
- `where: str | None = None`
- `fields: list[str] | None = None`
- `limit: int = 10`
- `order_by: str | None = None`
- `field: str | None = None`
- `layer_name: str | None = None`

#### `pro_run_gp`
Run ANY geoprocessing tool by dotted name, e.g. 'analysis.Buffer' / 'management.Dissolve'.

- `tool: str`
- `args: list[any] | None = None`
- `kwargs: dict | None = None`

#### `pro_server`
Server: status (warm-ups, what the arcpy thread is doing and for how long, cache, portal connections, jobs) | job (poll job_id; omit to list jobs) | guide (a playbook by topic, e.g. workflow, performance, portal-users, portal-layers, gotchas, safety, egdb; omit topic to list them - read one before an unfamiliar workflow) | toolsets (tool groups, ARCGIS_SALAH_TOOLSETS) | info (ArcGIS Pro version/licence) | ping (ArcPy reachable).

- `action: str = 'status'`
- `job_id: str | None = None`
- `topic: str | None = None`

#### `pro_symbology`
Layer symbology: categorized (unique values of field) | graduated (numeric field, classes=int, color_ramp) | utility (Esri AM/FM glyphs; classes=[{"value":10,"label":"Valve","symbol":"valve","color":"valve_black","size":14}], lines use width/dash) | water_utility (whole AM/FM water look; layers={"device","line","territory"} names) | symbols (glyph + colour names for utility).

- `kind: str`
- `aprx_path: str = 'CURRENT'`
- `layer_name: str | None = None`
- `field: str | None = None`
- `classes: int | list[dict] | None = None`
- `color_ramp: str | None = None`
- `map_name: str | None = None`
- `layers: dict | None = None`
- `font: str = 'water'`

### Toolset `live` (6 tools) - the OPEN ArcGIS Pro session through the SalahAIBridge add-in

#### `live_add_to_project`
Add an existing file to the OPEN Pro project: .sde/.gdb -> Databases (add-in 0.1.5+), .atbx/.tbx/.pyt -> Toolboxes (add-in 0.1.4+; a .pyt shows Pro's trust dialog the first time).

- `path: str`

#### `live_export_layout`
Export a layout from the open Pro session to a PDF (refused in read-only mode).

- `layout: str`
- `out_path: str`
- `dpi: int = 300`

#### `live_get_request`
Fetch what the user queued from the Salah MCP ribbon (Create Web App prompt / Publish). clear=True consumes it.

- `clear: bool = False`

#### `live_map`
The open Pro session's map: layers (active or map_name) | query (rows from layer: where, fields, limit) | zoom (to layer, or its selection) | add_layer (dataset path from disk; refused in read-only mode).

- `action: str = 'layers'`
- `map_name: str | None = None`
- `layer: str | None = None`
- `selection: bool = False`
- `where: str | None = None`
- `fields: list[str] | None = None`
- `limit: int = 10`
- `path: str | None = None`

#### `live_ping`
Liveness + context of the OPEN ArcGIS Pro session (project path, maps, layouts, add-in version).

#### `live_run_gp`
Run a geoprocessing tool LIVE inside Pro; output is added to the active map. Destructive: pass confirm=True (refused in read-only mode). Needs add-in 0.1.6+.

- `tool: str`
- `args: list[any] | None = None`
- `kwargs: dict | None = None`
- `confirm: bool = False`

### Toolset `egdb` (8 tools) - enterprise geodatabases on SQL Server / PostgreSQL / Oracle: create, connect, users and privileges, versioning, archiving, replication, administration

#### `pro_egdb_admin`
Administration (connect as the gdb admin): connected_users | disconnect (session IDs from connected_users, or all_users=true; confirm) | accept_connections | block_connections (e.g. before an upgrade; confirm) | maintenance (compress + analyze + rebuild indexes incl. system tables) | create_view (view_name + SQL SELECT definition, owned by the connected user) | config_keywords (keywords_action export|import, file).

- `action: str`
- `connection: str`
- `users: list[int] | None = None`
- `all_users: bool = False`
- `compress: bool = True`
- `analyze: bool = True`
- `rebuild_indexes: bool = True`
- `datasets: list[str] | None = None`
- `view_name: str | None = None`
- `definition: str | None = None`
- `keywords_action: str | None = None`
- `file: str | None = None`
- `confirm: bool = False`

#### `pro_egdb_connection`
Connections: create (.sde file, added to the open Pro project's Databases; version_type TRANSACTIONAL|HISTORICAL|POINT_IN_TIME|BRANCH + version; POINT_IN_TIME needs date 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS': UTC for non-versioned archives, server-local for versioned; count with a cursor, GetCount ignores the moment) | describe (connection: DBMS, release, user, version, datasets).

- `action: str = 'create'`
- `connection: str | None = None`
- `out_folder: str | None = None`
- `out_name: str | None = None`
- `database_platform: str | None = None`
- `instance: str | None = None`
- `user: str | None = None`
- `password_env: str | None = None`
- `database: str | None = None`
- `account_authentication: str = 'DATABASE_AUTH'`
- `version: str | None = None`
- `version_type: str | None = None`
- `save_credentials: bool = True`
- `date: str | None = None`
- `register_in_project: bool = True`

#### `pro_egdb_dataset`
Prepare data for multiuser work: prepare (Register With Geodatabase, Global IDs - needed for replication -, editor tracking, attachments) | register_versioned (traditional via a TRANSACTIONAL connection, branch via a BRANCH one; replication needs move_edits_to_base=false) | unregister_versioned (irreversible: confirm) | archiving (enable=true/false; disabling keeps the history table).

- `action: str`
- `dataset: str`
- `global_ids: bool = True`
- `editor_tracking: bool = False`
- `attachments: bool = False`
- `register: bool = False`
- `move_edits_to_base: bool = False`
- `compress_default: bool = True`
- `enable: bool = True`
- `confirm: bool = False`

#### `pro_egdb_principals`
Database users and roles: create_user (data owner/editor/viewer, optional role) | create_role (grant/revoke it to users) | drop_user | drop_role (confirm; never cascades; a logged-in SQL Server user is refused with the KILL statements a DBA must run) | set_password (password_env). SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle.

- `action: str`
- `admin_connection: str`
- `name: str`
- `password_env: str | None = None`

### Toolset `geoai` (5 tools) - deep learning, vision-language and foundation models, interview-first notebook generator

#### `pro_dl_notebook`
Make an arcgis.learn TRAINING notebook for ArcGIS Pro (detect, segment, classify pixels/objects, change detection) to run one cell at a time. Change detection can instead use Esri's ready-made Building Change Detection (no training, needs 10-20 cm before/after images: pass input_raster=before, second_raster=after). CALL FIRST with only `goal`: it replies status=ask_user (recommended model + the questions: batch size, epochs, learning rate...) or status=choose (plain "classification" is ambiguous: pixel / object / detect). ASK the user, never guess, then call again with the answers to get status=created. `options` = model-specific args e.g. {"backbone":"resnet34","pointrend":true}. out_path defaults to the open Pro project's folder. data_path_later=true ONLY if the user said they will type the data path. Add the file in Pro via Catalog > Notebooks > Add and Open Notebook.

- `goal: str = 'detect buildings'`
- `out_path: str | None = None`
- `model: str | None = None`
- `training_data: str | None = None`
- `batch_size: int | None = None`
- `epochs: int | None = None`
- `learning_rate: float | None = None`
- `chip_size: int | None = None`
- `val_split_pct: float | None = None`
- `options: dict | None = None`
- `mixed_precision: bool = False`
- `early_stopping: bool = False`
- `model_name: str | None = None`
- `input_raster: str | None = None`
- `input_features: str | None = None`
- `second_raster: str | None = None`
- `data_path_later: bool = False`
- `overwrite: bool = False`

#### `pro_geoai_infer`
Run models on imagery: detect (in_raster, out_features, model_definition; NMS on) | classify_pixels (out_raster and/or out_features) | classify_objects (label existing in_features) | change (in_raster=before, to_raster=after, out_raster) | embeddings (foundation model -> out_embeddings) | similar (embedding_features + query_features -> out_features, threshold) | foundation (Esri pretrained buildings/roads/trees: out_location, out_prefix, pretrained_models). Long runs: pro_batch background=true.

- `task: str`

- `connection: str = 'default'`

#### `portal_search`
Search items (newest first): query syntax title:"Parcels" AND tags:roads; item_type exact ("Feature Service", "Web Map", "CSV", "Dashboard", ...); owner ("me" ok). Org-only unless outside_org. Page with start/next_start. Titles are not unique - continue with ids.

- `query: str = ''`
- `item_type: str | None = None`
- `owner: str | None = None`
- `tags: list[str] | None = None`
- `max_items: int = 20`
- `start: int = 1`
- `sort_field: str | None = None`
- `sort_order: str = 'asc'`
- `outside_org: bool = False`
- `connection: str = 'default'`

#### `portal_share`
Share items: level private|org|everyone (everyone = public, needs confirm), add_groups / remove_groups (ids or exact titles). Verified per item (before/after).

- `item_ids: list[str]`
- `level: str | None = None`
- `add_groups: list[str] | None = None`
- `remove_groups: list[str] | None = None`
- `confirm: bool = False`
- `connection: str = 'default'`

### Toolset `portal_data` (3 tools) - hosted feature layers: query, edit, calculate, append, truncate, schema, views, renderers

#### `portal_layer_edit`
Change layer data: edit (adds/updates as attribute dicts or features - updates need OBJECTID; deletes = ids or where (confirm); batched, each result checked; dry_run previews a diff) | calculate (where + expressions [{"field","value"}|{"field","sqlExpression"}]; confirm) | append (source_item_id + upload_format csv/shapefile/filegdb/geojson/excel, upsert; confirm) | truncate (all rows; confirm).

- `action: str = 'edit'`
- `target: str = ''`
- `layer: int | str | None = 0`
- `adds: list[any] | None = None`
- `updates: list[any] | None = None`
- `deletes: list[any] | None = None`
- `where: str | None = None`
- `expressions: list[any] | dict | None = None`
- `source_item_id: str | None = None`
- `upload_format: str | None = None`
- `upsert: bool = False`
- `upsert_matching_field: str | None = None`
- `field_mappings: list[any] | None = None`
- `use_global_ids: bool = False`
- `rollback_on_failure: bool = True`
- `batch_size: int = 500`
- `dry_run: bool = False`
- `confirm: bool = False`
- `connection: str = 'default'`

#### `portal_layer_query`
Read a hosted/feature layer (target = item id + layer index/name, or a .../FeatureServer/N URL): describe (fields+domains, capabilities, count, is_hosted, is_view, view filter) | query (paged rows: limit<=2000, offset/next_offset; dates as ISO UTC) | count | stats (["sum:POP","avg:INCOME"], group_by).

- `action: str = 'query'`
- `target: str = ''`
- `layer: int | str | None = 0`
- `where: str = '1=1'`
- `fields: list[str] | None = None`
- `limit: int = 50`
- `offset: int = 0`
- `order_by: str | None = None`
- `return_geometry: bool = False`
- `stats: list[any] | None = None`
- `group_by: str | None = None`
- `distinct: bool = False`
- `out_sr: int | None = None`
- `connection: str = 'default'`

#### `portal_layer_schema`
Shape a HOSTED service: add_field (fields=[{"name","type":TEXT|SHORT|LONG|DOUBLE|DATE|...,"length","alias"}]; never on a view) | delete_field (confirm) | capabilities ("Query,Create,Update,Delete,Editing,Sync,Extract") | renderer (Esri JSON, or {"type":"unique","field"} / {"type":"class_breaks","field","classes"} / {"type":"simple","color"} built from the data) | labels (label_field or Arcade label_expression) | definition (raw update_definition, level layer|service; confirm) | create_view (view_name, view_where filter, view_fields, updateable=false read-only) | overwrite (data_file; confirm).

- `action: str`
- `target: str`
- `layer: int | str | None = 0`
- `fields: list[any] | None = None`
- `field_names: list[str] | None = None`
- `capabilities: str | None = None`
- `renderer: dict | None = None`
- `label_field: str | None = None`
- `label_expression: str | None = None`
- `definition: dict | None = None`
- `level: str = 'layer'`
- `view_name: str | None = None`
- `view_where: str | None = None`
- `view_fields: list[str] | None = None`
- `updateable: bool = False`
- `folder: str | None = None`
- `data_file: str | None = None`
- `confirm: bool = False`
- `connection: str = 'default'`

### Toolset `webapp` (2 tools) - static ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript 5.0 web apps and dashboards, GitHub deploy

#### `webapp_create`
Generate a static ArcGIS Maps SDK for JS 5.0 site from a webmap_id or layer_item_ids: kind=app (map + widgets: legend, layerList, search, basemapGallery, home) | kind=dashboard (map + live indicators + category breakdown + features-in-view list, recomputed as you pan; category_field/value_fields override the auto-picked fields).

- `title: str`
- `kind: str = 'app'`
- `webmap_id: str | None = None`
- `layer_item_ids: list[str] | None = None`
- `out_dir: str | None = None`
- `basemap: str = 'topo-vector'`
- `widgets: list[str] | None = None`
- `category_field: str | None = None`
- `value_fields: list[str] | None = None`

#### `webapp_github_pipeline`
Create a public GitHub repo, push the generated static web app, and (deploy_mode='live') enable GitHub Pages.

- `repo_name: str`
- `token: str`
- `deploy_mode: str = 'upload'`
